Additional Enrichment A
table.description:
Extra enrichment added to the open-loop enrichment at higher coolant and lower rpm.
Details: When used: A applies when coolant >= cal 0x13E18 and rpm < cal 0x13E0E, B when coolant < 0x13E1A or rpm >= 0x13E0C (in between the last value is held); the whole term needs FFF8A654 bit 1, whose thresholds (cal 0x13E08, 0x13E14) are 65535, and both tables are zero. Source of FFF8AFE8 (0x0CAF70, with B), a term of the commanded lambda and of the fuel factor FFF8AFBC, where it is added to the open-loop enrichment (0x0C558C, read). LT8H300D: same code as LF9K000D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Additional Enrichment B
table.description:
Second table of the additional enrichment, used at low coolant or high rpm.
Details: When used: see Additional Enrichment A: B applies when coolant < cal 0x13E1A or rpm >= cal 0x13E0C (A when coolant >= cal 0x13E18 and rpm < cal 0x13E0E; in between the last value is held), and the whole term needs FFF8A654 bit 1. Second source table of FFF8AFE8. LT8H300D: same code as LF9K000D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Additional Enrichment Throttle Threshold
table.description:
Throttle opening above idle, by rpm, needed to enable Additional Enrichment A/B.
0x0D3BFC (from 0x0C782C, args read) sets the Additional Enrichment enable FFF8A654 bit 1 only when, among others, FFF88A3C (throttle opening above the idle opening: FFF88A3A - FFF8AFB8, 0x08015C) >= this(rpm FFF8CD54) or FFF88EDA bit 0, and rpm >= cal 0x13E08 = 65535 and coolant >= cal 0x13E14 = 65535 (or FFF88E28 bit 1), so the enable never sets (read; my research notes section 3). Once met, the threshold becomes cal 0x13E12 itself (1049 = 2.4 %), not the table value minus 1049: the code computes threshold - (threshold - 0x13E12) (0x0D3C90-0x0D3CAE, read); the rpm and coolant hysteresis cals 0x13E0A/0x13E16 work the same way. Belongs to Additional Enrichment A/B. LT8H300D: same code as LF9K000D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Confidence: inferred.

Cranking Fuel (Repeat Attempt, Special Start)
table.description:
Cranking fuel pulse by coolant for a repeat attempt in the special start type.
Coolant-indexed base of the cranking pulse FFF8AFC6 (0x0C9038, read); used when flag s4 (= TGV-module flag FFF8A881 bit 2, read) set, s8 set, FFF8A6E7 = 3 (s8 = FFF811A7 bit 7, the repeat-crank history; argument mapping read from the calls at 0x0C589C). Cranking pulse (read, 0x0C9038): FFF842C8 = clamp(base x 256 x A67E x A687 x C535 x coolant multiplier x 64 / (2^32 x 255), 0, 524280) x 0.125 (the 64 is fixed, folded into the constant 5.843592e-11; Cranking Fuel Secondary Low Rail Pressure Multiplier 05A1FC acts only on the secondary pulse in 0x0C8A28), and the per-injector quantity is never below 10 x that (0x0D168C), in 0.8 us counts. Raw units: the factors' normalisation is not fully resolved, so change it proportionally. FFF8AFC6 feeds injectors in fuel mode 0 or 3. LT8H300D: same code as LF9K000D; address from the same instruction (similarity port (code)). Confidence: inferred.

Cranking Prime Pulse Coolant Multiplier
table.description:
Size of what appears to be a one-shot priming injection at key-on/cranking, by coolant; the pulse is proportional to it.
Details: When used: only if cal 0x28D98 = 1 or 2. 0x0CD4AC (read): FFF8A67D = this(coolant FFF8CD65 = degC + 50) during key-on and cranking (fuel state 1/2), held afterwards. 0x0CD500 / 0x0CD5DC compute the pulses FFF8C040 / FFF8C044 = 05A8F4 / 05A908(rail pressure FFF89266, FFF8A652) x flow compensation FFF8AFEA x barometric factor FFF8A687 x FFF8A67D x 2^-18 x 1.25 + latency, and 0x1D296C fires each of them once per injector (flags FFF8C6F4-C6F7) when cal 0x28D98 = 1 or 2 (read): a one-shot priming injection at start (inferred). The pulse is proportional to this value. LT8H300D: same code as LF9K000D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Running After-Start Enrichment 1 (Special Start)
table.description:
Running After-Start Enrichment 1 for the special start type, which is disabled by calibration.
Details: When used: start type FFF8A6E7 = 3 or above, in fuel states 2 (cranking) and 3 (running). Amount E1 (1/256 of fuel) for this start type, on coolant FFF88A44. 0x0CDD8C (read) builds FFF8B010: three amounts E1/E2/E3, each from a coolant table chosen by start type FFF8A6E7 (0 first start, 1 restart after key-off, 2 restart after stall, else special start; type and coolant FFF88A44 latched when fuel state 2/3 is entered (start of cranking, or a return from 3 to 2) for the amounts E1-E3, and latched again when fuel state 3 is entered (end of cranking) for the decay tables D1-D3), each faded linearly to zero over 8 x D passes of FFF8B06A (passes since fuel state 3, 0x0D1354) by its own decay table D1/D2/D3 (factor = clamp((8D - FFF8B06A) x 32 / D, 0, 255) / 256; no fade while cranking); FFF8B010 = max(E1, E2, E3) x 05AA60(rpm)/128 x FFF8A696/128 + Low Rail Pressure Start Enrichment, forced to 0 at load FFF8A616 >= cal 0x237C8 (255, hysteresis cal 0x237C9) and outside fuel states 2/3. FFF8B010 is summed with Warm-Up Enrichment FFF8B030 in the enrichment term of the fuel factor 0x0C558C (read), blocks long-term trim learning (0x0FFE40) and is read by the closed-loop controller 0x0FD76C. This is the running-path counterpart of After-Start Enrichment 1-3 (0x0CD834 -> FFF8B012, start path). LT8H300D: same code as LF9K000D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Start Injection Angle (Stop-Start Restart, Low Rail Pressure)
table.description:
Injection angle while cranking for a stop-start restart with rail pressure below 2 MPa. Stop-start cannot activate in this calibration, so probably unused. Not clamped by the ECU: keep it within 0.5-180 BTDC. Edit with the High Rail Pressure table.
Details: When used: while cranking (fuel state FFF8906B = 2) with the stop-start restart request FFF89066 bit 0 set and rail pressure FFF88884 below cal 0x2A65E (3279 = 2.0 MPa / 290 psi) (0x0CFB28, called from 0x0C589C with (906B, coolant FFF88A44, rpm/50, cal 0x38448 bit 7, FFF89066 bit 0, FFF88884, &FFF8B050, &FFF8B008), args read in the caller's disassembly). Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the injected cylinder's compression TDC (720 - code/2; larger = earlier), same scale as every injection-angle table (my research notes). It replaces Start Injection Angle (Fuel Mode 0) in FFF8B050, which 0x0CB394 uses as the first-pulse angle of injectors in fuel mode 0 (segment 3, offset B050 - 1080) (read). Unlike that table it is only floored at code 0, not clamped to 1080-1439, so keep it within 180-0.5 BTDC (code 1080-1439) (read). Setting cal 0x38448 bit 7 would force cal 0x11EBC (clamped to 1080-1439) instead. FFF89066 bit 0 = CAN 0x15A byte 2 bit 0, the restart request of the engine stop-start feature (signals_rates_can.md, my research notes, read). Edit with the High Rail Pressure table. LT8H300D: same code as LF9K000D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Confidence: inferred.

Only floored at code 0, not clamped (read): keep it within 180-0.5 BTDC (code 1080-1439). table.description:

Details: Feedback knock correction (0x0E2BE4, read): FFF8A79A is an s8 integrator kept at or below 0 and added directly to the fired timing (x 0.3516 degrees, 0x0D9E40): it is the only knock term of that sum, and FFF8A79A is one value for the whole engine, so a knock event on any cylinder retards all four (the fired timing FFF8A744 is recomputed per event for the next cylinder, but no per-cylinder knock retard exists; read). The state FFF8A79C (set once per combustion event by 0x0E2F94 from that event's knock results FFF8A7AD / FFF8A7B5; FFF8A7C1 is the knock-window-length flag (1 = extended window), used there only to reload per-cylinder hold counters FFF84920...FFF84930 from cal 0x27014 when it changes, purpose inferred) picks the action: states 0x0E, 0x0D, 7 and 6 subtract a step (floor = minus FBKC Maximum Retard); states 0x0C, 2, 0 (outside the rpm window) and the other non-knock states (0x0A outside the window, 0x0B) add the recovery step 0x1C271; 0x10 (inside the rpm window, no knock, fewer than cal 0x1C288 = 100 events since the last knock) holds the correction unchanged; 0x0F (inside the window, no knock, >= 100 events) adds 0x1C270, 8/9 add 0x1C272 (capped at 0); 5 = FFF8A79B x 0x1C26E / 128; 3 and 4 load the fixed values 0x1C26F / 0x1C278; 1 = 0.
